> We need AI that remembers."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why Mory?"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Today's AI is incredibly capable."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Yet every conversation starts from zero."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"It doesn't remember what you built yesterday."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"It doesn't know how you think."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"It doesn't understand years of your work."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The missing piece isn't a better model."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"It's **memory**."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Mory is building a **Personal Memory Operating System** — a place for the things you want AI to reme"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"mber, kept on your own device and available across your tools."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Instead of asking AI to remember you,"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Mory gives you ownership of your own memory."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The Mory vision — automatic capture and richer connections are still on the roadmap."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Vision"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Imagine asking:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> *"Continue the project I started six months ago."*"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Instead of searching through notes, chats and repositories..."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"AI immediately understands:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- what project you're referring to
